_meta.description: Star Rupture transport reference — rails plus the Cargo Dispatcher / Cargo Receiver pair. Used to pick optimal connection hardware per edge in the production graph.
_meta.source: Steam Community guide 'Rail & Transport Guide' (id 3645384098) and General Discussions threads (esp. 832738775777036595 'Cargo Receiver Dispatcher Math'). Capacities are nominal — real throughput depends on item stack size; see notes.

bundles.name: Multirail 3
bundles.notes: Bundles three parallel rails onto a single foundation width. Capacity = lanes × chosen rail tier.

bundles.name: Multirail 5
bundles.notes: Bundles five parallel rails. Known load-balancing issues in current builds — verify in-game before relying on full theoretical capacity.

cargo_dispatch._description: Cargo Dispatcher → Cargo Receiver pairs ship via drone over long distances. Drone packaging takes a fixed 10 s per stack, so throughput depends on item stack size as well as rail tier. The packaging-time floor means dispatchers never reach the rail's nominal speed alone — to saturate a same-tier output rail, run 2 dispatchers per receiver.

dispatcher.name: Cargo Dispatcher
dispatcher.notes: Packages one stack per cycle. Throughput = stack_size / (load_time + 10 s), where load_time = stack_size / (rail_throughput_per_sec).

receiver.name: Cargo Receiver
receiver.notes: One receiver can typically be fed by 2 dispatchers; using both receiver outputs can pull 3:1 or 4:1 ratios.

throughput_table_per_min._description: Items/min delivered by a single Dispatcher → Receiver pair, by item stack size × feeding rail tier. From the Steam guide's throughput table.

recommended_ratios.use: Saturate a single output rail of the same tier.
Saturate both outputs of a single receiver, mid stack sizes.
Saturate both outputs at small stack sizes (heavy packaging-time penalty).

notes: Rail throughput_per_min is the rail itself; the dispatcher pair will not match it unless 2 dispatchers feed each receiver.

For edge.rate_per_min recommendations: try rails first (smallest tier whose throughput >= rate). For long-distance connections where rails are impractical, fall back to dispatcher/receiver pairs and consult the throughput table by item stack size.
Item stack size is not currently captured in items_catalog.json — to compute exact dispatcher throughput per edge, that field would need to be added.
